idea-plugin.name: Unity Rider CLI Pipeline
idea-plugin.description:
Run Unity Test Framework tests from Rider without opening the Unity Editor UI.

Uses the official Unity CLI in batch mode (unity test): headless Editor, Test Runner, and NUnit report — then surfaces results in Rider's Unit Tests window.

Supports Edit Mode, Play Mode, and Player targets, so you can run the suite when the Editor is too heavy or not open.
